name: Boils
overview: Scripture presents boils as a severe physical affliction used by God as a form of judgment and testing, as seen in the plagues of Egypt where boils broke out on both man and beast (Exodus 9:9-10). The painful nature of boils is emphasized in Job, where Satan afflicted Job with sore boils from head to foot (Job 2:7). Healing is also depicted, with God providing means for recovery, such as the use of a fig plaster described in Isaiah 38:21 and the healing of boils mentioned in Leviticus 13:18. Additionally, boils are associated with divine chastisement in Deuteronomy 28:27, highlighting their role in God's disciplinary purposes.
